name: Goals by kick-off formation, and the ball gate for shots (task #4)
registered: 2026-10-19, before any test-half detection is computed or read
owner decision: goals + ball gate (2026-10-19): ~12 h; shots only if the gate passes
source plan: workflow wf_42c3ab6d-5bb, judge's plan 1 with grafts
known peeks (disclosed): While planning, read-only agents read the own-half share on M1 ground truth (3 runs 17-24 s after its 3 restartable goals, none at half starts) and on one M1 detection sample (2nd f000000, frame 1400).
One agent read the share at the first frame of all 18 cached halves, M5 2nd included (0.90-1.00).
So the M1 goals result is not blind; M5 2nd is the closest to blind.

GOALS.event: a formation run: on 1-s samples, the share of team-labelled people (players and goalkeepers; referees excluded) standing in their own half is >= T on >= N consecutive samples. A team's own half is the end it defends: its mean x over the half. Runs starting in the first 60 s of a half are ignored; runs less than 20 s apart are merged.

scoring team rules (grid).kick_spot: the team of the person nearest the centre spot at the run's last sample kicks off, so the other team scored
scoring team rules (grid).attack_end: the team whose half holds the players' mean x over the 10-40 s before the run conceded

GOALS.match: one to one: a run matches a BAS GOAL of the same half if it starts 15-60 s after it
GOALS.restartable goal: a BAS GOAL with a later action of the same half at least 15 s after it; others are reported as missed by construction
GOALS.dev selection on ground truth: T, N and the team rule maximising hits, then fewest false runs, then the larger T, then the larger N; the team rule is then frozen
GOALS.dev, detections: 128057_2nd (M7 2nd; 5 restartable goals at frames 2281, 37445, 46853, 53874, 67790): only T and N re-chosen within the grid: hits, then fewest false runs, then the larger T. Then all frozen in frozen_goals.json, hashed, before any test half is scanned.
GOALS.extra dev check: false runs on the 9 processed non-M1 windows (tracks_teams, 1 fps), reported, not used to choose
GOALS.pipeline: 1-fps pass over the whole half: yolov8s players (on the pitch-outline crop if the crop check passes: recall >= 0.99 and median box shift <= 1 px on 200 frames of M6 2nd f015000), feet to pitch metres (M1: calib_fix/calib_override.py; others: release), kit features and two-team clustering on the half's own detections.
GOALS.primary: hits over the 8 restartable test goals; false runs per 90 min over the 4 test halves
GOALS.secondary: scoring team right per hit (team_A/B to BAS left/right through the end each team defends); goal-time error (run start - 22 s); random-time baseline: the same number of runs at uniform random times, same matching, 1000 draws
GOALS.baseline: the current events.py goal rule (_in_goal): 0 goals on all 13 processed windows
GOALS.success: hits >= 7/8, false runs <= 1 over the 4 test halves, scoring team right on all hits but at most 1
GOALS.power: 8/8 gives Wilson 95% [0.68, 1.00]; this is 'works on these halves', not a rate

SHOT GATE.question: is the ball near the goals seen at all on footage v3 never trained on?
SHOT GATE.data: every BAS SHOT and GOAL of 128057 half 1 (10) and 132831 half 2 (16): 26 attempts
SHOT GATE.per attempt: a clip around the label frame; v3 (ball_v3b.1500.pt) at stride 1 on [-1 s, +2.2 s]; candidates with confidence >= 0.10; the painted marks of that match dropped; candidate feet to pitch metres with the release calibration
SHOT GATE.reachable: >= 2 frames with a candidate within 4 m of the GSR shooter in [-1 s, +0.5 s] AND >= 2 frames with a candidate within 4 m of the segment from the shooter to the centre of the goal his team attacks, in [0 s, +2 s]. The attacked goal: opposite to the end the shooter's team defends (its GSR mean x over the half).

decision.GO, capped: 9-12/26: shots may proceed, with expected recall capped at the reachable share in every report
decision.STOP: < 9/26: no shot or pipeline xG work; report 'shots not available: ball reachable k/26' with a Wilson interval

SHOT GATE.reproducibility: the 3 attempts already measured read-only (M7 f1370 and f3829 of 1st f030000 window time, M9 f2296) must come out not reachable; if not, the definition was not reproduced and the gate is re-checked before deciding
SHOT GATE.order: the M1 pass/carry result of the learned model (task #3) is read before any M1 shot output

XG: descriptive only: the frozen xGHub model (models/xg_xghub.json) on GSR shooter feet for all BAS SHOT/GOAL with an actor position; AUC with a half-block bootstrap, Brier against the base rate, quintile calibration; M1 shown apart. No threshold. Penalties cannot be told apart (no source).
PER PLAYER: no automatic per-person totals (identities fragment, ~14 tracks per person). Each detected goal gets a clip (run start - 45 s to run start - 15 s) for the coach to name the scorer.
